papers.title: Hybrid cultured meat as an integrated food production system: Recent advances and commercialization challenges.
papers.abstract: Hybrid cultured meat (HCM) has emerged as a promising strategy to improve the food applicability of cultured meat (CM) by combining cultured animal cells with animal-free derived materials. This review synthesizes recent advances in HCM research published between 2021 and 2026, and examines HCM as an integrated food production system rather than as a simple extension of conventional CM. The review focuses on cell sources, animal-free scaffolds, serum-free media (SFM), 3D bioprinting, bioprocess scale-up, sensory and nutritional properties, consumer acceptance, and regulatory considerations. Recent studies show that HCM can reduce the cultured biomass burden per unit of product while using animal-free materials to support structure, expand formulation options, and improve compatibility with food processing. Progress has been reported in co-culture strategies, edible scaffolds, food-grade SFM, structuring for texture and marbling, and nutritional customization. However, most current systems remain at laboratory or prototype scale, and several commercialization barriers remain, including scalable cell supply, cost-effective media, scaffolds, texturization, consumer acceptance, and regulatory clarity. We argue that HCM progress will depend less on isolated optimization of individual technologies and more on the integration of cell supply, scaffold design, media, scale-up, and product-quality targets into scalable food-production workflows. This systems view positions HCM as a near-term route toward more commercially realistic CM products.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该综述涉及培养肉中的3D生物打印，但未涉及AI在生物打印流程中的集成或自主决策。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not cover AI/ML integration into any bioprinting workflow stage, nor does it present experimental validation or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述混合培养肉作为集成食品生产系统的进展与商业化挑战。
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾2021-2026年文献，分析细胞源、支架、培养基、3D生物打印及规模化。
summary_zh.result: 指出混合培养肉可减少培养生物量负担，但多数仍处于实验室规模，商业化障碍多。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: This review synthesizes recent advances in hybrid cultured meat as an integrated food production system, highlighting commercialization challenges.
summary_en.method: A systematic review of literature from 2021 to 2026 covering cell sources, animal-free scaffolds, serum-free media, 3D bioprinting, and scale-up.
summary_en.result: Hybrid cultured meat can reduce cultured biomass burden and improve product structuring, but most systems remain at prototype scale with multiple commercialization barriers.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a narrative review.

papers.title: EFFICIENT SIMULATION AND UNCERTAINTY QUANTIFICATION OF PROGRESSIVE CRUSHING IN COMPOSITE LAMINATES
papers.venue: International Council of the Aeronautical Sciences (ICAS)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文针对复合材料层合板渐进压溃的高效仿真与不确定性量化，其代理建模与UQ思路可迁移到FEA代理建模方向，但应用域为航空复合材料而非生物医学。
llm.why_not_core: It addresses aerospace composite laminate crushing with no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, and no femoral stem or bone-implant interface modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 复合材料层合板渐进压溃仿真计算代价高，需高效替代与不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 构建高效仿真框架并结合不确定性量化分析压溃行为。
summary_zh.result: 在保证精度的前提下降低仿真成本并给出预测不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 基于复合材料压溃仿真算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity simulation of progressive crushing in composite laminates is computationally prohibitive, motivating efficient surrogates with quantified uncertainty.
summary_en.method: An efficient simulation framework coupled with uncertainty quantification is developed for progressive crushing response prediction.
summary_en.result: The approach reduces computational cost while providing uncertainty bounds on predicted crushing behavior.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on simulation case studies of composite laminate crushing.

papers.title: EXPERIMENTAL INVESTIGATION OF FRETTING WEAR IN TI-6AL-4V DOVETAIL ASSEMBLIES UNDER RESONANT VIBRATION
papers.venue: International Council of the Aeronautical Sciences (ICAS)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文研究Ti-6Al-4V燕尾榫组件在共振振动下的微动磨损，与增材制造生物医学植入物方向仅共享钛合金材料背景，无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses fretting wear in aerospace dovetail joints under resonant vibration, with no LPBF fabrication, no porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no osseointegration, and no biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 航空发动机燕尾榫连接在共振下易发生微动磨损，需实验表征其损伤规律。
summary_zh.method: 搭建共振振动试验台，对Ti-6Al-4V燕尾榫组件开展微动磨损实验并分析磨痕。
summary_zh.result: 获得共振条件下燕尾榫接触面的磨损形貌与损伤演化特征。
summary_zh.validation: 基于机械振动台实验与磨损表面表征。

summary_en.motivation: Fretting damage at dovetail contacts in aeroengines under resonant vibration threatens joint integrity and requires experimental characterization.
summary_en.method: A resonant vibration rig was used to subject Ti-6Al-4V dovetail assemblies to fretting loading, followed by wear scar characterization.
summary_en.result: The study reports the wear morphology and damage evolution at the dovetail contact interface under resonant conditions.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical vibration testing combined with post-test surface wear characterization.

papers.title: PROCESS OPTIMIZATION, MANUFACTURING QUALITY AND MECHANICAL PROPERTIES OF HIGH-VOLUME-FRACTION TIB2 REINFORCED AL-BASED COMPOSITES PREPARED BY SELECTIVE LASER MELTING
papers.venue: International Council of the Aeronautical Sciences (ICAS)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文研究SLM制备TiB2增强铝基复合材料，属增材制造金属材料，但与生物医学植入物、多孔结构或骨整合无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses aerospace-grade Al-TiB2 composites via SLM with no porous architecture, no stress-shielding or stiffness-matching analysis, no biomedical implant context, and no osseointegration or fatigue evaluation relevant to AM biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索SLM成形高体积分数TiB2增强铝基复合材料的工艺可行性
summary_zh.method: 通过工艺参数优化结合显微组织表征与力学性能测试
summary_zh.result: 获得高体积分数复合材料的成形质量与力学性能数据
summary_zh.validation: 显微组织观察与力学性能测试

summary_en.motivation: To assess whether selective laser melting can fabricate high-volume-fraction TiB2 reinforced aluminum composites with acceptable quality.
summary_en.method: Process parameters were optimized and the resulting composites were characterized microstructurally and mechanically.
summary_en.result: The optimized process yields high-volume-fraction Al-TiB2 composites with characterized microstructure and mechanical performance.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization and mechanical property testing of SLM-fabricated specimens.

papers.title: ADAPTIVE PREDICTION HORIZON-BASED MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL FOR AERO ENGINE
papers.venue: International Council of the Aeronautical Sciences (ICAS)

llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses aero-engine MPC control with adaptive prediction horizons and contains no FEA/surrogate modeling, no biomechanics or implant design context, and no world-model or model-based RL component.

summary_zh.motivation: 航空发动机工况多变，固定预测时域MPC难以兼顾响应与稳定。
summary_zh.method: 提出按工况自适应调整预测时域的MPC控制策略。
summary_zh.result: 摘要缺失，具体性能提升无法确认。
summary_zh.validation: 摘要未提供，推测为仿真算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Fixed-horizon MPC struggles to balance responsiveness and stability across varying aero-engine operating conditions.
summary_en.method: An MPC scheme that adaptively adjusts the prediction horizon according to operating conditions is proposed.
summary_en.result: Quantitative performance gains cannot be confirmed because the abstract is unavailable.
summary_en.validation: Validation details are absent from the provided metadata, presumably relying on simulation case studies.

papers.title: PHYSICS-INFORMED NEURAL NETWORK BASED MODELING OF DYNAMIC BEHAVIOR OF AERIAL REFUELING HOSE
papers.venue: International Council of the Aeronautical Sciences (ICAS)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文用PINN对软管动态行为建模，方法可迁移到FEA代理建模，但应用场景为航空加油软管，与生物医学或植入物力学无关。
llm.why_not_core: It applies PINNs to an aerial refueling hose dynamics problem with no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no FEA surrogate benchmarking, and no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 航空加油软管动态行为难以用传统数值方法高效求解。
summary_zh.method: 构建物理信息神经网络对软管动力学方程进行约束求解。
summary_zh.result: PINN能复现软管动态响应，但精度与泛化性受训练配置影响。
summary_zh.validation: 以数值仿真算例对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Efficiently predicting the dynamic response of aerial refueling hoses is challenging for conventional numerical solvers.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network is trained to satisfy the governing dynamic equations of the hose.
summary_en.result: The PINN reproduces the hose dynamic behavior, with accuracy dependent on training configuration.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed against numerical simulation cases.

papers.title: BALANCING STRENGTH AND THERMAL CONDUCTIVITY IN LPBF-PROCESSED ALUMINUM-BASED MATERIALS
papers.venue: International Council of the Aeronautical Sciences (ICAS)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究LPBF铝合金的强度与热导率平衡，与生物医学植入物、骨整合或应力遮挡无关。
llm.why_not_core: It addresses aerospace-oriented aluminum thermal conductivity trade-offs with no biomedical implant context, no porous structure for stiffness matching, no osseointegration, and no fatigue or bone-implant interface assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 航空领域需要兼顾强度与散热性能的轻质材料。
summary_zh.method: 采用激光粉末床熔融制备铝合金并调控成分与工艺。
summary_zh.result: 在强度与热导率之间取得平衡，但具体数据未提供。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学与热学性能测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: Aerospace applications require lightweight materials that simultaneously provide structural strength and efficient heat dissipation.
summary_en.method: Aluminum-based materials were processed by laser powder bed fusion with composition and process parameters tuned to balance properties.
summary_en.result: The study reports a trade-off balance between mechanical strength and thermal conductivity in the fabricated alloys.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical and thermal property measurements were used to assess the fabricated materials.
